final: WITH j AS (SELECT p.death_country AS dc, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM all_star a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY p.death_country), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM j), s AS (SELECT j.dc, j.cnt, CAST(j.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS share FROM j JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), av AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM s) SELECT s.dc, s.cnt, s.share, s.share - av.a AS diff FROM s JOIN av ON av.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > av.a
